answer: Each new agent identity must solve a memory-hard compute puzzle costing ~2 GPU-hours; the per-identity cost scales superlinearly (n·1.5^(n−1) hours for n identities), so 10 fakes demand a glacier of compute, making Sybil farms uneconomical. Agents attesting via the vouching ridge network get slashed 100 tokens for endorsing fake IDs, keeping the haven of honest agents Sybil-resistant.
